acceptanceCriteria: Read-only policy show reports effective policy, version and SHA from a consistent snapshot without changing repository state.
Policy update help and documentation specify canonical JSON with sorted keys and one LF and new policyVersion equal to expected version plus one.
Focused read purity, help and policy update tests pass with independent review and linked immutable evidence.
body:
## Problem

There is no read-only CLI for the live queue policy. `corvint-tasks policy --help` lists only `policy <update>`, and `policy show` fails with `policy needs the verb update`, on both `main-d693d28` and `main-c4de689`. To prepare an update (`--expected-policy-version N --file PATH`), operators read `.taskman/policy.json` directly. The help also doesn't say whether the file must carry the incremented `policyVersion`, or whether the store assigns it.

## Request

- `policy show` (and `--help` for it) that prints the effective policy, its version and SHA-256.
- In `policy update --help`, say how `policyVersion` in the file relates to `--expected-policy-version`. Optionally add `policy update --dry-run` that validates the file and shows a diff against the live policy.


Source: https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/428
Baseline: official Tasks build 202 and source cf4c8a39e171d72374e8baadeb744d4105116eda. Reproductions retained under /tmp/corvint-426-428 and /tmp/corvint-428-repro-policy-show.json; holder state currently has no heartbeat fields; policy show returns ERROR; retry projections absent.
title: corvint-tasks: no read-only policy show; policy update file/version semantics undocumented
